jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - US
jobs.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Why This Role Matters Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Clinical Data Effectiveness
jobs.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.
